reviews.text: Very pleasant staff working in a small environment. We did not realise there is permit parking

I liked the way Venus was handled and to discus in full her condition and treatment. A scan was recommended to find out more of what the problem was and this was done on the same day. We were then able to come home with Venus and her medication.
All the staff are so wonderful at looking after our dog, through routine check ups to when she is poorly. She loves going in, all the fuss she gets and the treats.
Thank you for leaving a review :)

Easy booking at short notice.
Relaxed calm atmosphere (which helped with puppy’s first visit to the vet’s) and all the staff were very friendly.
Seen straightaway with the health check & vaccination completed in minutes.
Plus, free local parking.
Will use this branch again.

How amazing are Pool House Vets I visited the Vet in Mere Green today with my Mimi 🐆 very calm and peaceful and it is one appointment at a time so no others in waiting room before appointment. From the courteous friendly receptionist to the brilliant chill vibe of the vet that suggested relaxant meds for next visit for full wellbeing check nails clip ears teeth etc actually weighted Mimi at 5.1 kg so my guess of 5kg was close. Next appointment on Mimi 🐆 7th birthday in July. Lucky lucky 77 to have found this vet for her. Mimi at home after the visit most certainly a paradigm away from when I took her to other vets emergency. Gratefully happy.🙏🏽🥰
Myself and my dog feel very at ease at Pool House Vets. First class care!

We wanted to give a shout out to Delphina, who looked after our boy with a torn dew claw. Our dog is very fearful of the vets and she was so patient and understanding with our little one, and managed to remove the claw safely and it has healed really well.

Pool House was recommended to me by a groomer. My dog, Lucy is the second dog I have brought here. The staff are friendly and the atmosphere is all about the pets. I can't say it is the favourite destination for Lucy, but at least she's quite happy to go in! I've found that animals are treated kindly and with warmth.

I had a really positive experience with Pool House Vets - Mere Green Branch. The team were professional, caring, and genuinely compassionate from the moment we arrived. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made both me and my pet feel comfortable throughout the visit.

The clinic was clean, well organised, and the staff were friendly and attentive. It’s clear they truly care about animal welfare and providing excellent customer service. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and supportive veterinary practice in Sutton Coldfield.
Really friendly and informative staff.

Very friendly Receptionist on entering the practice. The service we have received from the Vet is extremely good. So much better to have continuity in treatment. The whole experience is very reassuring.  Can definitely recommend this practice.
Always friendly and efficient

Recently visited Poole vets and had a very good consultation with them .My dog had injured his leg but thankfully soft tissue damage .
A friendly team .
Excellent service ,vet and receptionist abby 👏 juliette Pearce …
Very kind and caring. Knowledgeable when it comes to our guinea pigs.
Always a happy visit. Would highly recommend this practice

I am still heartbroken after losing my beloved SiuPak, but I would like to express my deepest gratitude to Amy, the receptionist at the Mere Green Branch. Throughout every step – from appointments to prescriptions and all my enquiries – Amy has been nothing short of outstanding. Her kindness, patience, and understanding have been such a comfort to me during this very difficult time. She has always gone above and beyond to make sure I felt supported and cared for, and that means the world. Amy is truly a star in the Mere Green team, and it is because of her compassion and professionalism that I would wholeheartedly recommend this practice to my friends. THANK YOU AMY xx!
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your feedback :)

This is by far the best vets we have used. Our previous vets don’t match up to the standard and care you get from mere green pool house vets practices. From the team on reception to the vets themselves are all professional and welcoming. We know Our 3 kittens are in good hands when they visit.
Thank you for your 5* review.

Very friendly welcoming practice and everything explained clearly as to what they have to offer. No problem with getting quick and convenient appointments when required. Been using this vets since I had ny kitten just over a year ago. I would definitely recommend them.
Thank you for your 4* review.
Visited PHV in Mere Green today and Laura on reception and Lawrence the Vet couldn’t have been more helpful . Very impressed with  service and advice.  Thank you Alfie and Casper
